newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Colonial ordered to re-open public offer.
newsitem.headline: Colonial ordered to re-open public offer.

text.p: Insurance and banking groupu Colonial Ltd said on Friday it has been ordered to re-open its public share offer by corporate regulator the Australian Securities Commission (ASC).
Colonial said the offer would re-open immediately and close on May 6.

Colonial managing director Peter Smedley said in a statement the board had decided to close the offer on April 28, four days earlier than the expected close date, following a strong response by shareholders.
Smedley said before the decision to close the group had consulted with both the ASC and the Australian Stock Exchange, from whom the group received no objection to the proposal.

The effect of reopening for the receipt of further applications for shares and options would be that allocations to each investor would be less than the minimum application size of 1,000 shares and options, Colonial said.
All applications currently held by Colonial which were received after noon on April 28 will be immediately processed, it said.
